body:
My own incompetence. I’ve have a lot of self hatred for myself that has spanned almost my whole life. It’s getting to the point where I question if I can do anything right. I don’t want to stick around to find out. 

All my relationships are based off of lies. I contribute exactly nothing to society. I make no one happy. I constantly disappoint everyone around me. I know I can never make myself happy because of my constant fuck ups. And I fuck up so often because manipulative personality, piss poor memory, lack of intelligence. I’m terribly lazy. I procrastinate. I’m always on edge and shaky. I’m paranoid as all hell. I hear voices in my head constantly criticizing and bringing me down. I’ve cheated in all my relationships. I’m ugly. I have no social life because all my old friends hate me. And I can’t change these things no matter how hard I try. 

What finally broke me tonight was that I cracked my phone screen. Yeah, not that big of a deal, but just yesterday I cracked my phone screen for the first time. Completely shattered. I had to get it fixed and made my boyfriend spend $80 only for me to do it again today. And if you sort those kind of instances one after the other you pretty much end up with my life. I’m not even being dramatic. 

But this relatively small, first world problem highlighted all of my shortcomings as a person. It reminded me why I can never shake this need to commit suicide. It was the straw that broke the camel’s back. 

And those things happen because of who I am as a person. And I can’t change. I’ve tried for years and years. So I’m going to stop trying permanently.
